name: Compute Kernel — Phase 3: Inference Primitives
description: Add inference primitives: model weight loading, quantized matmul path, embeddings generation, KV cache management, sampler boundary, streaming token output, and checkpointable execution state for resumable inference.
purpose: Local inference as a governed, receipted, checkpointable service — not ad-hoc ML library calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Model weight loading with versioned registry metadata in PGlite
Quantized matmul path supports common quantization schemes
KV cache management with explicit eviction policies
Streaming token output for real-time inference
Checkpointable execution state enables pause/resume of inference
Session-scoped inference jobs with compute receipts
